# quickwit_tokenizer (Data Source)

Builds a custom tokenizer, to pass to `quickwit_index.doc_mapping.tokenizers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "quickwit_tokenizer" "trigram" {
  name     = "trigram"
  type     = "ngram"
  min_gram = 3
  max_gram = 3
  filters  = ["lower_caser"]
}

data "quickwit_field_text" "title" {
  name      = "title"
  tokenizer = data.quickwit_tokenizer.trigram.name
}

# Pass the tokenizer JSON to quickwit_index.doc_mapping.tokenizers.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Field name. Dots must be escaped (`\\.`) to be part of the name.
- `type` (String) Tokenizer type: `ngram`, `regex`, `simple` or `source_code`.

### Optional

- `filters` (List of String) Token filters, applied in order: `remove_long`, `lower_caser`, `ascii_folding`.
- `max_gram` (Number) ngram: maximum gram length.
- `min_gram` (Number) ngram: minimum gram length.
- `pattern` (String) regex: the token pattern.
- `prefix_only` (Boolean) ngram: only emit grams starting at the beginning of the token. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Canonical JSON document (all defaults explicit, keys sorted), as returned by Quickwit.
